about_the_game:
Unravel the mystery of Knotgud in this off-beat, fantasy, mystery. Use wonderous tools to look into the past, smell magic, and snoop pockets. Discover subjects to fill out your Scroll of Truth and piece the facts together word by word. Interrogate over 20 suspects to figure out, WHO SUMMONED IT?

The Kingdom of Knotgud needs you! A terrible creature known as the Booglo has been summoned and torments the land! Thankfully Riki Rocktoe, the soft-boiled Truth-Meister is on the case. But he's not alone, accompany Riki as the possessed Scroll of Truth that only allows true statements to be written on it. Yes, you're a piece of parchment. A magical piece of parchment!

Features

  • Explore the town and interrogate the good folk of Knotgud.

  • Meet a diverse cast of over twenty suspects.

  • Investigate the environment and scrutinize statements to reach conclusions.

  • Use magical tools to aid you in your investigation. Look into the past with a cracked crystal ball, get into tiny spaces with all-purpose-rats. Smell the different colors of magic with an enchanted cat. 

  • Solve various mysteries throughout Knotgud in non-linear progression. 

  • Discover clues, phrases and use logical deduction to complete fill in the blank style mysteries.
